body.statement: The DKW construction yields \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}\Pr_P\{(\tau_{t,\ell})_{t>T_0}\in\mathcal C_\ell(R^{\mathrm{DKW}}_\ell)\}\geq1-\alpha\) for every \(n_\ell,m_\ell\), and \(R^{\mathrm{DKW}}_\ell=O(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\) uniformly. For \(\alpha<1/2\), two legal smooth-pre and Bernoulli-post subexperiments imply that no uniformly honest ball has worst-case diameter \(o(n_\ell^{-1/2}+m_\ell^{-1/4})\).
body.justification: This supplies an always-valid fallback whose shrinking order is not sacrificed when sharp calibration cannot be certified.
body.gap: Chernozhukov et al. invert simultaneous CDF bands into pointwise-in-quantile envelopes; they do not give the learned-weight simultaneous \(L^2\) radius or its two-sample minimax order.
body.consumer: The result gives a defensible simultaneous uncertainty summary for the complete post-period abundance-QTE path relative to the donor-identified no-intervention counterfactual.
